item.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update - 09/22/2026
item.description:
💡REMINDER:

For players experiencing issues with the new Street Fighter 6 Wildcard event, please ensure that you have updated Apex Legends today. You will be able to load into matches without updating, but your overall experience may be hindered - fully closing Apex and downloading the update should resolve most issues.

item.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.4.3d
item.description:
Greetings, Descendants.

We would like to inform you about the details for The First Descendant Hotfix 1.4.3d.

This patch will be applied without a client update, allowing immediate access without additional downloads.

For Descendants currently in-game, please return to the title screen and reconnect to apply the patch.
